title: Alert record
description: One alert of a monitoring component for one patient in one scenario.

scenario_id.title: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Identifier of the intervention scenario, as in the scenario table.

patient_id.title: Patient ID
patient_id.description: Identifier of the patient, as in the baseline record.

day.title: Day
day.description: Day of the alert, counted from therapy start (day 1).

source.title: Source
source.description: Monitoring component that gave the alert.

true_alert.title: True alert
true_alert.description: True if an adverse event was developing at the time of the alert.

event_type.title: Event type
event_type.description: Type of the developing adverse event, as in the event table. Null for a false alert.

attended.title: Attended
attended.description: The patient was reached and came to the visit that the alert called for.

acted.title: Acted on
acted.description: The care team recognised the event because of this alert.
